# Real-world-pattern test messages

Composite messages written for testing JobXray. They are not copied from any source.
Each follows a scam pattern described by consumer-protection sources:

- FTC consumer alert on fake recruiter texts: https://consumer.ftc.gov/node/331470
- CyberPeace, "Internship Scams: Exposing Financial Frauds Targeting Students":
  https://cyberpeace.org/resources/blogs/internship-scams-exposing-financial-frauds-targeting-students

`expected.json` lists the funnel stages each message should produce, written before
the model was run.
